occurrences.name: Panchpatmali Bauxite Mine
occurrences.geological_formation: Eastern Ghats Mobile Belt (Khondalite Supergroup protolith)
occurrences.lithology: Gibbsitic bauxite blanket capping flat plateau (>1150m ASL), underlain by lithomargic clay and weathered garnet-sillimanite-graphite khondalite
occurrences.source: GSI Bulletin Series A No. 46 / IBM National Mineral Inventory / NALCO Annual Reports
occurrences.verification_method: Statutory Mining Lease Boundary Survey & Published Corporate Technical Reports

occurrences.lithology: Gibbsitic bauxite duricrust forming high plateau summit (~1080m ASL)
occurrences.source: IBM Mining Lease Atlas / Odisha DGM Mineral Inventory

occurrences.name: Damanjodi Central Bauxite Sector

occurrences.name: Amarkantak Bauxite Belt
occurrences.province: Central India Maikala Range Laterite Province
occurrences.geological_formation: Deccan Traps & Lameta / Archaean crystalline basement contact
occurrences.lithology: High-level plateau laterite ('pat' morphology >1000m ASL) derived from prolonged sub-aerial weathering of basalt flows

occurrences.verification_method: Published GSI Economic Geology Memoir & Mining Lease Atlas

occurrences.name: Mainpat Bauxite Plateau
occurrences.lithology: Flat mesa plateau (>1050m ASL) preserving a 4-8m thick blanket of laterite and aluminous bauxite pockets

occurrences.name: Radhanagari Bauxite Plateau
occurrences.lithology: Laterite caprock on high-elevation plateau overlooking the Konkan coast
occurrences.source: IBM Mining Lease Atlas / Maharashtra DGM
occurrences.verification_method: Published Directorate of Geology and Mining Lease Records

scientific_guidelines.explanation: High-altitude tropical weathering creates extensive lateritic iron-aluminum duricrusts. Remote-sensing SWIR (B11/B12 Al-OH absorption) maps hydroxylated phyllosilicates and gibbsite, but cannot determine commercial grade (% Al2O3 vs % reactive SiO2 and Fe2O3) without chemical assay.
scientific_guidelines.rationale: Optical spectral features and DEM plateaus identify prospective geomorphic laterite plateaus, but cannot substitute for chemical core-assay grade estimation. Numerical prospectivity predictions are withheld to preserve scientific integrity.
